bugs.why: The wordmark declares "Penny Rounded" first, which does not exist, so it renders in a fallback font.
13px #C2C2C2 helper text on white is 1.78:1, below 4.5:1.
34px 800-weight heading at 3.56:1 is large text, which only needs 3:1.
One filled primary button with an outlined secondary under it is a clear ranking.
The date field's left edge is x=29, 5px right of the x=24 column every other field shares; no rule declares it.
A bulleted list indented a deliberate 20px, beyond the 12px near limit.

bugs.why: The receipt card has a fixed 340px width: it fits at 390px but runs past the viewport edge at 320px.
The streak chips scroll horizontally inside their own overflow-x:auto box; the page does not scroll.
The email input uses 14px text, which makes iOS Safari zoom in on focus.
The password input uses 16px text, so it does not trigger the zoom.
